description: Returns saved parish announcements for an ended or interrupted public session, preferring the edited announcements section and otherwise its summary tab. The response excludes sermon and full-recording fallbacks. text_type identifies AI-edited or summarized text rather than guaranteed verbatim speech. Recording and summary-update dates are not announcement expiry dates. Text is limited to 8000 UTF-16 units; truncated and total_chars describe completeness. No AI generation or network retrieval occurs. Shared reference rate limits apply.

session_id.description: Exact public recording session ID, for example from a sermon listing or an msza.ai recording URL. The recording must contain saved announcements.

name: get_announcements

total_chars.description: Public text UTF-16 length before response truncation.

title: Read public parish announcements
